name: WonderCon
blurb: Comic-Con International's spring convention at the Anaheim Convention Center, with 900+ exhibitors, panels, artists' alley and autograph signings.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'WONDERCON 2027: MARCH 26-28 ANAHEIM CONVENTION CENTER' and 'We look forward to seeing you next year on March 26-28, 2027!'

notes: Sister event to San Diego Comic-Con, run by the same organization (filed separately as san-diego-comic-con.json). The official Special Guests page (/wc/things-to-do/special-guests/) was rendered with --mode guests and shows no real guest candidates yet, only nav/logo imagery, so guests is 'none-yet' for the 2027 edition.
